title: Generate a Random Permutation of the Elements of a List
required_features: Polymorphic occurrence-sensitive multiset/bag equality for lists, rather than a set or length approximation.
Effectful/probabilistic random selection of a finite-list occurrence without changing the public unary OCaml interface.
Effect-aware verification; finite-run tests can check individual outputs but cannot prove randomness or an unstated distribution.
semantic_obligations: permutation has exact OCaml interface 'a list -> 'a list.
Every output contains exactly the input occurrences, including duplicate multiplicities, and no others.
Every output has the same length as its input.
Ordering is random; no fixed output order is required or inferred from the illustrative official example.
Do not add a seed, RNG state, option, exception, or altered interface not stated by the source.
notes: No contract.sq or synthesis logs are produced. A length/set-only Synquid refinement would materially weaken occurrence multiplicity and randomness, so running it would not be a valid synthesis attempt.
